result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **SignWell for value, Dropbox Sign for simplicity, or DocuSign for a more established, professional setup.**

You probably don't need an expensive enterprise e-signature platform. The best option is one that makes it easy to send contracts, collect signatures, track outstanding documents and automatically store completed agreements.

## My top 5 e-signature platforms for small businesses

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. SignWell**

(Best value overall)

## \$10 USD/month

- Unlimited documents on the paid Light plan.
- Reusable templates and automated reminders.
- Audit trails and multiple signers.
- Free plan for 3 documents per month.

Ideal for consultants, contractors and small businesses wanting affordable, straightforward signing.

Pricing: annual billing; monthly option costs \$12.

[SignWell pricing](https://www.signwell.com/pricing/)

---

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for simplicity)

## \$15 USD/month

- Unlimited signature requests on paid plans.
- Easy-to-use signing experience.
- Reusable templates.
- Integrates with Dropbox.

Ideal if you want a professional, simple process without unnecessary features.

Essentials individual plan; annual billing.

[Dropbox Sign pricing](https://sign.dropbox.com/products/dropbox-sign/pricing)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. DocuSign**

(Best established platform)

## AU\$15/month

- Widely recognised by customers and businesses.
- Strong integrations.
- Document tracking and audit trails.
- Templates and signing workflows.

Ideal if you regularly send contracts to clients, suppliers or employees.

**Important\:** The Australian Personal plan only includes 5 envelopes per month. Standard is AU\$37/user/month with 100 envelopes per year.

[DocuSign Australia pricing](https://ecom.docusign.com/en-AU/plans-and-pricing/esignature)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales and proposals)

## \$19 USD/user/month

- Create professional proposals and quotes.
- Add pricing tables and product information.
- Collect signatures and track documents.
- CRM integrations on higher plans.

Ideal if you want to create, send and sign client proposals in one system.

[PandaDoc pricing](https://www.pandadoc.com/pricing/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

(Best for PDF workflows)

- Strong PDF editing and signing capabilities.
- Document preparation and tracking.
- Useful Microsoft and Adobe integrations.

Ideal if your business already uses Adobe Acrobat extensively.

[Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-signature.html)

## Quick comparison

| Platform | Best for | Starting price |
|--------|--------|--------|
| SignWell | Best value | \$10 USD/mo |
| Dropbox Sign | Simplicity | \$15 USD/mo |
| DocuSign | Established business | \$15 AUD/mo |
| PandaDoc | Proposals and quotes | \$19 USD/user/mo |
| Adobe Sign | PDF workflows | Varies |


Prices are indicative advertised starting prices, not necessarily Australian checkout prices. Annual billing, taxes and usage limits matter. [www.signwell.com](https://www.signwell.com/pricing/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[sign.dropbox.com](https://sign.dropbox.com/products/dropbox-sign/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[ecom.docusign.com](https://ecom.docusign.com/en-AU/plans-and-pricing/esignature?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.pandadoc.com](https://www.pandadoc.com/pricing/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for before choosing

For a small business, I'd prioritise\:

1. **Unlimited or generous signing allowances** – avoid paying more as your business grows.
2. **Reusable templates** – save time on recurring contracts.
3. **Automatic reminders** – chase clients who haven't signed.
4. **Audit trails** – keep evidence of who signed and when.
5. **Automatic document storage** – easily retrieve signed agreements.
6. **Australian legal suitability** – check that the signing process meets the requirements for your particular documents.

In Australia, electronic signatures are recognised for most Commonwealth processes under the Electronic Transactions Act 1999, although exceptions and state legislation apply. [www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions/electronic-signatures?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
